description: Recommended development DAG and artifact names, not existing repository APIs or completed work. Paths in task outputs are relative to the future implementation checkout. Current deliverables contain only planning contracts.
global_rules: Do not run measurements with unresolved required contract fields.
Retain original JPEG q and quantization tables; no RGB roundtrip, recomputed DCT, requantization, or silent coefficient clipping in matched adapters.
Resolve K_source from real transform dependencies; output channel count and guessed full-64 defaults are not dependency evidence.
Keep native B32/Q50 and IC triangular-search reproductions in a separate contract and results table.
Treat IC/FS JPEG-DCT and training adaptations as paper-guided implementations, not recovered original source code.
Record every assumption, tuning budget, format change, and source of paper-specified settings.
All tasks remain planned until their outputs and gates are actually checked.

tasks.title: Inspect the repository and resolve source, model and training configuration

required: Locate actual input entrypoints, source manifest and coefficient oracle.
Locate each target model profile, checkpoint or initial training snapshot.
Import actual model batch, precision, optimizer, augmentation and tail policies rather than invent defaults.
Record supported source geometry/sampling, dependencies and software versions.
gate.on_failure: Keep unresolved fields null; stop dependent development choices that rely on them.

tasks.title: Freeze the semantic interfaces and shared coefficient/request oracle

required: All run-required paths and hashes resolve to immutable artifacts.
Extract existing JPEG q/Q exactly and freeze component, geometry and frequency-order interpretation.
Materialize occurrence-level sample order and augmentation/Mixup decisions.
Separate explicit source-frequency dependencies from final output channels and verify against a full-source oracle.
Freeze writer/reader/request/tensor/result interfaces and justified operation-specific numerical tolerances.
gate.on_failure: Do not start independent backend implementations against an ambiguous interface.

tasks.title: Implement IC Shared and FixedK matched adapters

required: Use per-image NPZ/ZIP-DEFLATE with int32 source-q storage and necessary numeric geometry/Q metadata.
Preserve exact q/Q and replay the common runtime transformations.
FixedK uses a proved source-dependency mask and records per-profile copies; no baked crop/resize or new quantization.
Label B8 full/irregular masks as adapter extensions; native k=B does not mean B squared coefficients.
Any batched, native-inflate, Zstd, or GPU-decode variation has a separate documented variant label.
gate.on_failure: Do not emit comparable performance rows.

tasks.title: Implement FS matched B8 diagonal storage and reader

required: Use 15 u+v diagonals for B8 and a default physical group of 256 images, distinct from model batch size.
Use NPZ/ZIP-DEFLATE and exact signed int8/int16 range selection with no overflow/clipping.
Read touched whole diagonal/group units, then account for exact frequency/image/spatial gathering.
Measure cross-image and spatial overread; do not add an implicit scalar-column or spatial-index design.
Preserve quantization tables, geometry, logical ordering and tail-group samples.
gate.on_failure: Keep the adapter unqualified for matched measurements.

tasks.title: Build trace replay, asynchronous timing, accounting and result export

required: All methods receive the same trace and model contract, with equal resource/tuning budgets.
Include planning, full reads/metadata, H2D, transformation, logical reordering and final CUDA completion in the declared boundary.
Permit fair CPU workers, pinned staging and cross-batch overlap; prevent preparation of measured requests before the start boundary.
Export complete H2D and application/physical I/O separately, storage metadata, memory peaks and offline costs.
Distinguish actual, emulated and modeled results, recording cache warmth separately; validate JSON records against result.schema.json.
gate.on_failure: Do not treat produced timings as reportable measurements.

tasks.title: Verify the final integrated backends before timing

required: Verify exact source-q/Q roundtrip, signed width edges, component mappings, partial diagonals and segment/group tails.
Verify supported crop/resize/flip/augmentation/Mixup cases, repeated occurrences and logical output ordering.
Compare final tensors and inference logits against the source oracle with the frozen tolerance contract.
Compare loss, gradients and short parameter updates from identical model/optimizer state.
Every primary matched method passes; failing variants remain marked failed and cannot enter the headline table.
gate.on_failure: Return to the responsible backend or contract task; do not relax tolerances to conceal a semantic discrepancy.

tasks.title: Tune within equal budgets and measure diagnostic corner cases

required: Freeze per-method runtime configurations after equal-budget worker/prefetch/pool tuning.
Recheck final numerical equivalence if configuration changes arithmetic or transformation placement.
Cover frequency-only requests with proved dependencies, real-profile crop cases, low/high pool occupancy and independent/shared crop traces.
Verify cache state and complete byte accounting; label any throttle or analytical bandwidth model explicitly.
Record raw repeated runs and keep diagnostics separate from full-dataset throughput claims.
Validate IC/IC-b/FS native B32/Q50 format semantics on identical coefficients and an explicitly shared mask; distinguish family-wide persistent bytes from per-request bytes.
Measure equal-budget multi-consumer sharing with at least 1/2/4 consumers, including complete diagonal-prefix budgets and shared storage groups.
gate.on_failure: Resolve the concrete measurement or resource-budget issue before full runs.

tasks.title: Run full validation correctness and inference measurements

required: Process the complete agreed validation split with identical IDs, tail handling, checkpoint, profile and precision.
Record measured Top-1/Top-5 and prediction/numerical equivalence for each matched path.
Collect at least three formal timing runs under each declared main cache condition and preserve raw results.
Include startup/final drain in closed-window timing and separately identify any steady-state statistic.
Do not use a different checkpoint's accuracy or an IC/FS native-quality point to annotate the matched result.

tasks.title: Run one matched training epoch and assemble reproducible evidence

required: Start every method from identical model and optimizer snapshots after non-mutating or reset warmup.
Replay the full epoch with identical sample occurrences, augmentations, gradient accumulation, tail/padding and optimizer update count.
Reconcile actual sample counts, final updates, complete wall-clock boundary, traffic and memory accounting.
Preserve contracts, hashes, software revisions, checkpoints, raw runs, conversion costs, correctness evidence and all implementation deviations.
State that quality-policy convergence and native IC/FS Pareto comparisons require separate contracts/experiments; do not infer them from one matched epoch.
gate.on_failure: Do not mark the agent implementation or experiment package complete.
